title: Marking the Trail

intro.speaker: silas
intro.text: The winter storms knocked over the stones that mark the trail. Without them, walkers could get lost in the mist.

intro.speaker: silas
intro.text: We mark it with a pattern, so anyone can tell it's the trail. Can you carry on the pattern?

steps.speaker: silas
steps.prompt: Carry on the pattern of stones. What comes next?

older.prompt: Carry on the pattern: big, big, small, big, small. What comes next?

feedback.all_good: The trail is marked all the way up. Nobody will get lost now!

outro.speaker: silas
outro.text: A walker in the mist will see those stones and know they're on the right path. You've helped someone you'll never meet.

journal_line: I marked the mountain trail with a pattern of stones with Mr. Silas.
